heading: How to Do It in BC
title:
1. Check the procedure is an NP restricted activity, and read its limits in the BCCNM advanced procedures standard (Key Sources).
2. Look up whether it is core or non-core, and the criteria for it, in the BC MQI Nurse Practitioner dictionary (Key Sources).
3. Agree with your employer on the additional education and how your competence will be checked, using the BCCNM quick reference (Key Sources).
4. In a health authority setting, request the privilege through your medical affairs office or AppCentral; a procedure not in the dictionary goes in as an additional privilege request.
5. If the standards don't answer your question, ask [BCCNM Standards Support](https://public.bccnm.ca/standardssupport).
